scenes.sub: Risk you don't want can often be hedged, insured or engineered away, at a cost. This module covers hedging, cover, liquidation protection, stress testing and what to do in the first hour of a crisis.

scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: Hedge: a position that offsets another's risk. Protective put: an option capping downside below a price. Cover: on-chain insurance for defined events. Stress test: a what-if shock on your book. Incident: an exploit, depeg or compromise.
scenes.cap: Hedge: a position that offsets another's risk. Protective put: an option capping downside below a price. Cover: on-chain insurance for defined events. Stress test: a what-if shock on your book. Incident: an exploit, depeg or compromise.

scenes.vo: Beginner: Knows the hedge tools and what they cost. Practitioner: Hedges one real exposure and runs the five stress tests. Master: Runs a stress-tested book with a rehearsed incident playbook.
